quests.dispatcherQuestion: A landslide has cut off a rural valley community after a week of unusually heavy rain. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how essentials can reach a community with no road.
quests.explanation: An airlift is the only reliable way to bring in food and medicine while the only road remains blocked.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A resident in the valley urgently needs dialysis treatment that can't wait for the road to clear. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to her specifically, ahead of others.
quests.explanation: Prioritizing her medical need ensures she reaches treatment in time, even while others safely wait for the road.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers clear a temporary single-lane track through the landslide after three days of work. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what limited traffic the new track should carry first.
quests.explanation: Limiting the fragile new track to essential vehicles first protects it from damage before it's fully reinforced.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional water treatment plant reports a mechanical fault has let untreated water reach part of the supply. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the strongest public warning needed here.
quests.explanation: A do-not-drink notice is stronger than a boil notice, since some contaminants aren't removed by boiling alone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Officials need to identify exactly which streets are supplied by the affected part of the plant. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what needs to be identified before targeted help can go out.
quests.explanation: Mapping the exact streets means only genuinely affected households are warned and supplied, not the whole region.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Repairs are complete and water samples confirm the supply is fully safe again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the earlier warning.
quests.explanation: Lifting the notice only after sample testing ensures residents aren't told it's safe before it truly is.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional sports stadium reports a partial roof panel has come loose in high winds during a match. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which part of the crowd is at risk.
quests.explanation: Moving fans from directly beneath the panel protects them if it comes loose completely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the panel is now secure but recommend checking the rest of the roof. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what wider check should now happen.
quests.explanation: A full inspection rules out other weak panels before fans are allowed back into any part of the stand.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The inspection finds no other issues and the stand is confirmed fully safe. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the stand is confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Reopening only after a full, confirmed inspection means fans return to seats that are genuinely secure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional blood transfusion center's cold storage has failed overnight, threatening the whole local supply. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the immediate action to save the supply.
quests.explanation: Moving the blood to working cold storage quickly is the only way to prevent the entire stock from being lost.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The nearest working cold storage is at a hospital twenty minutes away. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what kind of vehicle keeps the stock safe on the move.
quests.explanation: A refrigerated vehicle keeps the blood at a safe temperature throughout the twenty-minute journey.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All stock has been safely moved and confirmed still within safe temperature limits. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the original faulty unit.
quests.explanation: Repairing the original unit restores full capacity so the center isn't relying on borrowed space long-term.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional news report causes panic buying, and a supermarket's crowd is growing dangerously large at the doors. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how the crowd at the doors should be managed.
quests.explanation: Letting in small groups at a time prevents a crush at the entrance while keeping the store running.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Staff report shelves are emptying fast and tempers are rising among waiting customers. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what rule can make supplies last for everyone.
quests.explanation: Purchase limits mean supplies are shared more fairly instead of a few people taking everything.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A calm public announcement about restocking the next morning helps ease the crowd's worry. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what specific information should be shared with customers.
quests.explanation: A specific time gives anxious customers a clear reason to calmly come back rather than crowd the doors now.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional dam operator reports water levels are approaching the maximum safe limit after weeks of rain. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the planned technique used to lower levels safely.
quests.explanation: A controlled release lowers the water level gradually and safely, rather than risking an uncontrolled overflow.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Downstream residents need advance warning before the controlled release raises the river level. Input code!
quests.hint: Say who must be told before the release begins.
quests.explanation: Warning residents beforehand lets them move boats, animals, or belongings before the river level rises.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The release is complete and the dam is confirmed back to a safe operating level. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what final check reassures downstream residents.
quests.explanation: A public confirmation reassures residents that the planned release worked and the danger has passed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional airport's runway lights have failed as an evening flight is due to land in the dark. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the safest immediate option, given the failed lights.
quests.explanation: Diverting to another airport with working lights is far safer than attempting a landing on a dark runway.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers confirm the light failure was caused by a single damaged cable, now identified. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what specific fix is needed.
quests.explanation: Repairing the exact cable found faulty gets the lights working again without unnecessary delay.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The runway lights are fully restored and tested ahead of the next scheduled landing. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the lights are confirmed working.
quests.explanation: Resuming operations once fully tested ensures the next flight lands under normal, safe conditions.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large regional recycling plant fire is producing toxic smoke that's drifting toward a nearby town. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the safety instruction for the town in the smoke's path.
quests.explanation: Sheltering indoors with windows shut protects residents from breathing in smoke while the fire is brought under control.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Health officials need to monitor air quality readings in the town throughout the fire. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what equipment should be set up in town.
quests.explanation: Monitors give officials real data to decide when it's genuinely safe to lift the shelter advice.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The fire is out and readings confirm air quality in the town is back to normal. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the earlier instruction.
quests.explanation: Lifting the advice once readings are confirmed normal lets residents safely open windows and go outside again.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional blood donor drive at a college has a student faint during the donation process. Input code!
quests.correctAnswer: LAY HIM FLAT AND ELEVATE LEGS
quests.hint: Say the standard first-aid position for fainting.
quests.explanation: Elevating the legs helps blood flow back to the brain, which is the standard treatment for a simple faint.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: He wakes up but feels dizzy and staff want to be cautious before he leaves. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the cautious next step before letting him go.
quests.explanation: A short monitoring period confirms he's fully recovered before he's allowed to stand up and leave.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: He feels completely normal after resting and staff clear him to go about his day. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the final decision once he's confirmed recovered.
quests.explanation: Clearing him only after confirmed recovery ensures he doesn't leave and faint again somewhere less safe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A regional bridge inspection finds unexpected corrosion on a support cable used by thousands of commuters daily. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the immediate precaution while a full check is arranged.
quests.explanation: Lowering the speed limit reduces stress on the bridge immediately, while engineers plan a fuller inspection.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A full engineering assessment is needed to judge whether the corrosion is dangerous. Input code!
quests.hint: Name the specialist who can judge if it's safe.
quests.explanation: Only a structural engineer can properly assess how serious the corrosion is and what repair it needs.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The engineer confirms the corrosion is minor and the bridge is safe at normal speeds. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the bridge is confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Restoring the normal limit once confirmed safe avoids needless daily delays for thousands of commuters.
